text:
For a minor speck I was seen by an elderly female doctor who speaks incomprehensible english. Pill pusher too: prednisolone, antihistamine and antibiotics and more, all these were totally not needed (except for her making money), I threw them away (and I stayed healthy).

My blood pressure was not taken and no questions asked about any allergies! Some people are allergic to penicillin and the doctor should ask about it.
Would not recommend.
